title: Fix container startup after Aikido removal
verification: Live GET https://api.egdata.app/health returned 200 with healthy Redis and MongoDB after correcting the service startup arguments.
Live GET https://api.egdata.app/countries returned 200 after correcting the service startup arguments.

endpoints.before: After removal of the Aikido dependency, both Docker image startup commands still preloaded @aikidosec/firewall/instrument. Containers exited with MODULE_NOT_FOUND before listening, causing origin-backed requests to fail with gateway errors.
endpoints.after: Both Docker images start Node directly with source maps and dist/index.js, restoring origin availability without the removed preload. Existing route contracts, authentication, origin access controls, gateway quotas and custom anti-abuse behavior are preserved. Responses handled entirely at the gateway are unaffected.
endpoints.clientAction: Retry requests that failed during the outage. No request format or authentication changes are required.
